একজন গণিতবিদের কাজ কখনো একটি পরিচিত ধারণ: A mathematician’s work need not remain within one familiar idea. John Nash’s life shows that pursuing deep questions, thinking in new ways, and sustaining supportive relationships through difficult times are all parts of a researcher’s story.

তাঁর কাজ অবশ্য game theory-তেই সীমিত ছিল: His work was not limited to game theory. He also made important contributions to geometry, manifolds, and partial differential equations. In 1994, he received the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences with John C. Harsanyi and Reinhard Selten. In 2015, he shared the Abel Prize in mathematics with Louis Nirenberg. Princeton’s account and the Abel Prize biography describe this breadth of his work.
জীবনের পথ সব সময় সরল ছিল না: Life’s path was not always straightforward
ন্যাশ গুরুতর মানসিক অসুস্থতার মধ্য দিয়ে: Nash experienced serious mental illness. It profoundly affected his personal and professional life, and his research progressed intermittently over a long period. He later returned to Princeton, where colleagues and students offered him respect and companionship as a member of the mathematics department. University records also describe the support of his wife Alicia and the compassion of the Princeton community.
তাঁর গল্পকে “অসুস্থতা থাকলেই প্রতিভা আসে: His story should not be reduced to simple messages such as “illness creates genius” or “willpower alone can overcome every obstacle.” Mental illness brings real distress and a need for support. One lesson from Nash’s life is that a research path may take unexpected turns, and family, treatment, and a supportive community can matter greatly in helping someone move forward.
